characters.description: Young Indian woman, long black hair, pastel blue saree
Young Indian man, white shirt, dark trousers

scenes.description: Woman walks alone in the rain, man appears from behind a building.
scenes.image_prompt: Woman in pastel blue saree walking in the rain, man in white shirt and dark trousers appears from behind a building.
scenes.motion_prompt: Subtle movement of raindrops, man's silhouette emerging from behind the building.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the rain, then close-up of man's silhouette.

scenes.description: Man and woman exchange glances, man offers his umbrella.
scenes.image_prompt: Woman with umbrella, man with open umbrella, both looking at each other.
scenes.motion_prompt: Man gently offers his umbrella, woman accepts with a smile.
scenes.camera: Medium shot of the couple, then close-up of their faces.
scenes.lighting: Soft street lighting, man's shadow on woman's face.

scenes.description: Man and woman walk together, man holds her hand.
scenes.image_prompt: Man and woman walking together, man holding her hand, both smiling.
scenes.motion_prompt: Man gently holds her hand, woman smiles back.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the couple walking, then close-up of their hands.
scenes.lighting: Soft street lighting, man's shadow on woman's face.

scenes.description: Woman leans into man, they share a kiss.
scenes.image_prompt: Woman leans into man, both smiling, man's arm around her, they share a kiss.
scenes.motion_prompt: Woman leans into man, they share a gentle kiss.
scenes.camera: Close-up of their faces, then wide shot of the couple.
scenes.lighting: Soft street lighting, man's shadow on woman's face.
